svg.aria-label: The path: lanes against time, with a now line at September 20, 2026. A ship-fence band under the axis says the fence LIFTED on September 20, when W4's first cut landed, and that no W5 ship lane has opened yet. Two input lanes from other epics: the W3 floor, FIX-1351, carries a bar reaching the now line, landed, seats, channels and skills on disk, and DevForce's first build slice; and the W4 first cut, FIX-1407, carries a bar reaching the now line, first cut landed, epic In Review, with two dead-code and documentation strays left in backlog that are not part of the first cut. Then the rows of the set. FIX-1467, references versus resources, carries a solid in-flight bar crossing the now line, reading spec in review, pull request 1957, the only W5 work in flight, with a dashed not-started continuation. FIX-1455, the kitchen-sink child epic, is a dashed not-started line beginning just after the now line, reading held, its own lifecycle, unfenced but not started, and it is proving surface one. Two further lanes carry no bar at all, only labels: devtool observability, reading no child, not filed, proving surface two, no duration to draw; and basic DevForce, reading no child, not filed, proving surface three, its first slice done in W3. Last in the set, a short terminated lane for FIX-1458, humans in seats, whose bar stops at September 20 with an end cap, reading canceled by the owner, pull request 1955 closed unmerged, kept so the set shows what was dropped. The critical path is drawn in the gutter as dots on the four live and unfiled set lanes; it is solid from FIX-1467 to FIX-1455 and then drawn as a broken line through the two unfiled lanes, because the route to the done condition runs out of owners there. A note says the set is open and more lanes are expected. Under a divider, three related lanes that are not in the set: the manager-queue lab FIX-1430, consumed, W4-side; org never optional FIX-1442, which is wrap-gating because the done condition is not observable without org identity; and the Collab park FIX-1341, later and never the whole of W5.
svg.text: THE PATH — ONE LANE PER ROW OF THE SET, AGAINST TIME
